## Schladming-Dachstein

### Your year-round adventure in Styria, Austria

Schladming-Dachstein is centrally located in the Alps, nestled between the Dachstein massif, the Schladminger Tauern and the Grimming. The region comprises 13 municipalities and is renowned for [authentic nature experiences](https://www.schladming-dachstein.at/en/activities), regional cuisine and a wide range of leisure activities – [whatever the season.](https://www.schladming-dachstein.at/en/schladming-dachstein-discover/seasons)

## Skiing

### in the heart of Austria


With 222 km of pistes, the Schladming-Dachstein region is the ski center of Styria. The 9 ski mountains offer variety and diversity for every skill level. At the heart of it all is the 4-mountain Schladming ski area with Hauser Kaibling, Planai, Hochwurzen and Reiteralm.

## Winter start

## 2026/27


The winter season in Schladming-Dachstein has begun! The cross-country skiing season in Ramsau am Dachstein kicked off on 6 November. From the end of November, the ski resorts will gradually open for the season. In December, the Ski Opening and evening activities on the Hochwurzen will provide even more winter highlights.

## Cross-country skiing

### in the Nordic center of Austria


The high plateau of Ramsau am Dachstein offers a variaty of trails for classic technique and skating with up to 220 kilometers. In addition to highlights such as the high-altitude trails on the Dachstein or the night trail in the Ramsau stadium, the valley trails complete the cross-country skiing offer in the Schladming-Dachstein region.

## Off the slopes

### The diversity of winter awaits here


Schladming-Dachstein is the winter sports center of Styria and offers a range of activities for all those who want to enjoy winter in all its facets. Whether it's a leisurely winter hike, tobogganing by day or night, a ski tour or a horse-drawn sleigh - a winter wonderland awaits you here.
